entries.title: Ukraine: Oleshky residents evacuate war-ravaged city

entries.title: What the rift within the Tsikhanouski family means for the Belarusian opposition in exile

entries.title: US midterms: Pope Leo XIV casts vote by mail

entries.title: Seoul fears being sidelined as US reaches out to North Korea

entries.title: Bollywood and the underworld — together in the spotlight?

entries.title: Bayern Munich's Kenya friendly highlights Africa's growing pull for global sport

entries.title: Italy: Students and workers rally over living costs

entries.title: Germany takes cautious approach on Israeli election results
entries.snippet: German politicians have been slow to respond as they wait to see who is likely to comprise the next coalition. Many are also hoping for a government without religious hardliners.

entries.title: Russia: Critical newspaper 'Novaya Gazeta' to close

entries.title: Brazil's new anti-gang law: Can it curb organized crime?

entries.title: IIHF ordered to allow Russia back into world championships

entries.title: Many Turkish 'guest workers' hit by poverty in old age

entries.title: The dachshund, a humorous icon with political symbolism
